title: Rapper Lil Tecca Set as Newest Fortnite Festival Icon (Gaming News Roundup)
description:
Lil Tecca is bringing his music to the gaming world as the Season 15 Icon for Fortnite Festival.

	Beginning this Thursday, players can purchase new
body:
Lil Tecca is bringing his music to the gaming world as the Season 15 Icon for Fortnite Festival.

	Beginning this Thursday, players can purchase new Festival gear with the Neon Dreams Music Pass, including the Lil Tecca Outfit, Mic Mace Pickaxe, Tecca’s World Back Bling and a guitar inspired by the rapper’s Dopamine Tour. Also available is a Mic Stand inspired by the album cover of “We Love You Tecca.”


	The collaboration will also bring four new Jam Tracks: “Ransom,” “Dark Thoughts,” “Love Me” and “500lbs.” 
	

	See more gaming news from this week in the roundup below.
	
		NEW RELEASES	

	Netflix-owned Next Games released “Netflix Minigolf,” available July 28.

	A little bit mini golf, a little bit pinball and a little bit “Mario Kart,” Netflix’s new party game allows up to four players to shoot their best shot from their living room.

	The game features over 60 levels featuring Netflix top titles like “Bridgerton,” “Squid Game” and “Stranger Things.” Courses and avatars from “KPop Demon Hunters” launch later this year.

	Players putt their way through the courses and collect “Pranks,” which can be used to sabotage other players. And in the spirit of the game’s anarchy, the lowest score doesn’t always win.

	The game is accessible via the Netflix platform on compatible TVs. Players use their phones as controllers, connected to the game via a QR code.

	*

	Daybreak Games and Game Jawn announced the release of “EverQuest Legends,” a solo-friendly version of the 1999 MMORPG “EverQuest.”
	

	Available for PC, the game includes nostalgic elements from the 1999 original — such as the playable races of Iskar, Frogloks and Kerran with the original zones and spell effects — while incorporating new features and modern gameplay systems. Players can explore Norrath solo, in groups of four or in raids of up to eight players while selecting up to three different active classes per character.

	The live service game features the continents of Antonica, Faydwer and Odus, with increasing difficulty as players level up. Featuring a monthly subscription model, “EverQuest Legends” will receive regular updates, including the arrivals of Deity Achievements, the Rurjarkian Hills Open World Zone and the Nektropos Castle Mini-Expansion in upcoming months.

	“EverQuest Legends” was developed in collaboration with Game Jawn and is available on the “EverQuest Legends” website.

	Watch the trailer below.


	
		PARTNERSHIPS/COLLABS	

	Spider-Man is swinging his way back to Fortnite this Thursday ahead of the upcoming release of “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.”

	The collaboration will feature two new outfits — a “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” Outfit inspired by the three cinematic superheroes and The Punisher Outfit — and a Friendly Spider-Man NPC. Web Shooters will also be returning alongside an in-game Web Shooter Hour.

	To celebrate the superhero’s return to the gaming platform, Fortnite is showing an exclusive clip from “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” introduced by Tom Holland both in the game and on its official YouTube channel.

schema.headline: Rapper Lil Tecca Set as Newest Fortnite Festival Icon (Gaming News Roundup)

title: Brazilian Erotic Thriller ‘The Riverbank’ Boarded by Premium Films, MPM Premium Ahead of Locarno Competition Premiere (EXCLUSIVE)
description: Paris-based Premium Films, together with its feature film sales division MPM Premium, has acquired international sales rights to Matheus Farias and
body:
Paris-based Premium Films, together with its feature film sales division MPM Premium, has acquired international sales rights to Matheus Farias and Enock Carvalho’s “The Riverbank” (“A Margem do Rio”).

	The atmospheric erotic thriller will world premiere in the prestigious international competition at the upcoming Locarno Film Festival, taking place in Switzerland over August 5-15. 


	The duo’s feature debut comes five years after their short film “Inabitável” made waves at the Sundance Film Festival and a year after Kleber Mendonça Filho’s “The Secret Agent” catapulted the filmmakers’ home and hub of Recife into a major international platform. 
	

	The film also consecrated Farias as one of the country’s most renowned editors, with his winning a Platino Award for his work on the Oscar-nominated picture. “The Riverbank” features several “The Secret Agent” actors, including Robério Diógenes, Kaiony Venâncio and Carlos Francisco. 


	Set in Recife, it follows young cleaner Izaquiel (Caique Copque), whose nightly search for intimacy leads him to magnetic fisherman Jeremias (Ítalo Martins). As violence closes in, both embark on a journey into the depths of the mangroves, where reality and myth intertwine, exposing the invisible structures of power that govern their world.

	“We were immediately captivated by the way the characters’ stories intertwine within the wild, nocturnal world of Recife’s mangrove forest,” said Jean-Charles Mille, general manager of Premium Films & MPM Premium. “Predator and prey, desire and danger, the unconscious and class politics become inseparable in a thriller charged with erotic tension and simmering suspense.”
	



	

					‘The Riverbank’.  Courtesy of Gatopardo Filmes
	



	The exec added that what “impressed” his team the most “is how Matheus and Enock transform genre into a powerful cinematic language.” “‘The Riverbank’ moves effortlessly between mystery, sensuality and tropical magical realism while confronting systems of domination, abuse of power and ideological control with remarkable emotional depth. It is a bold work of auteur cinema that remains gripping from beginning to end, and we believe its singular artistic voice will resonate with audiences well beyond the traditional boundaries of genre or queer cinema.”

	Asked by Variety about the film’s refined balance of genres — the story traverses the classic erotic thriller to experiment with the tropical noir, crime drama, magical realism and even a hint of whodunnit —  Farias said he and Carvalho have been professional and life partners for 13 years, so they have a “unified vision of what cinema can be.” “The elements of genre cinema were already present in our early films, the shorts, but it was never something we approached in a particularly calculated way. The tone of our stories is directly connected to what is unfolding within them.” Faria added Mati Diop’s “Atlantics” and Ali Abbasi’s “Border” as tonal and visual references. 

	“In ‘The Riverbank,’ this comes from the experience of the protagonist Izaquiel,” adds Carvalho. “There is the reality of life, of the real places, of the routine of work, but there is also the space of myth and non-realism. In between all that, the story comes in desire and danger, and that’s where the thriller, crime and eroticism emerge. In the film, desire, fear and enchantment are always very close to one another. It all comes naturally, such as the mangrove forest. It is something we are used to seeing every day in our city, something that is part of the territory itself.”



	

					Courtesy of Gatopardo Filmes
	



	“The Riverbank” paints a sharp criticism of the complex, often corrupt, ties between evangelical churches and politics in Brazil. As the country gears up for a tense presidential election this coming October, how vital did it feel for the filmmakers to broach the issue onscreen? 

	“We recently lived through some very difficult years in Brazil because of the movement known as ‘Bolsonarismo,’” says Faria, referring to the right-leaning political and ideological movement centered around former president Jair Bolsonaro. “We watched an extremist political project take shape, bringing together authoritarian ideas, the overt persecution of minorities and artists and a highly pro-gun campaign. The country’s largest evangelical churches and religious leaders played a major role in all of this, so for us as gay men, those were years marked by great fear.”
	

	Farias also notes a personal connection, mentioning he spent two decades within an evangelical church. “It was like watching a worldview I had once helped sustain become the political project of an entire country. The problem was that, by the time this happened, I was already on the other side of that history, suffering the consequences of those very same ideas. When you leave an institution that has shaped the way you think about your body and your relationship to desire, those marks do not simply disappear. I think the film also comes from that wound.”

	Speaking about the impact of “The Secret Agent” on the film scene in Recife, and the visibility its success gave northeastern stories, Faria says it was “incredible” to watch the film’s broad reach. “I think it has sparked greater curiosity about other films being made in Recife and across Brazil.”

	“It opens doors, creates new conversations and allows local professionals and projects to be seen by people who might not have been looking in our direction before,” he adds. “I think ‘The Riverbank’ is also arriving in Locarno at a moment of heightened attention around Brazilian cinema. But it is important to say that this did not begin with a single film. Recife has a very strong cinematic tradition built over many decades.” Earlier this year, Variety published an in-depth report on the history of filmmaking in the region and how the capital became a booming production and creative hub. 

	“The Riverbank” is a Brazilian-German co-production produced by Gatopardo Filmes, Moçambique Audiovisual, Vitrine Filmes, and Tama Filmproduktion. The film is supported by Projeto Paradiso, the World Cinema Fund, the Hubert Bals Fund, Ancine and Funcultura Audiovisual.

title: Michael J. Fox Will Be Honored With TV Academy’s Bob Hope Humanitarian Award at the Emmys
description: Michael J. Fox has been tapped to receive one of the Television Academy‘s biggest honors, the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award, at this year’s Emmy Award
body:
Michael J. Fox has been tapped to receive one of the Television Academy‘s biggest honors, the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award, at this year’s Emmy Awards. The org announced the news Wednesday, noting that the kudo was “in recognition of his transformative contributions to Parkinson’s disease research and advocacy.”

	Fox is already an Emmy nominee this year; he’s among the performers competing in the outstanding guest actor in a comedy series category via his role on Apple TV’s “Shrinking.” That award will be given out during the nontelevised Sept. 6 Emmys; his Bob Hope Humanitarian Award will be telecast on NBC (his one-time “Family Ties” home) as part of the 78th Emmy Awards on Sept. 14.
	

	The Bob Hope Humanitarian Award was created in 2002, with Oprah Winfrey as its first recipient. The idea was “to honor a member of the telecommunications industry whose philanthropic efforts exemplify Bob Hope’s own decades-long altruism and positive impact on society.” 


	The Television Academy and the Bob & Dolores Hope Foundation jointly find an honoree “whose humanitarian efforts have brought credit to the industry and whose deeds and actions have had a lasting impact on society.”

	Last year, Ted Danson and Mary Steenburgen received the honor. Although it has been around for 24 years, this will only be the sixth time it has been given: Besides Winfrey, Danson and Steenburgen, past honorees are Danny Thomas (given posthumously in 2004), George Clooney (2010) and Sean Penn (2022).

	Fox has been nominated for 19 Emmys and has won five, including three consecutive lead comedy actor wins in 1986, 1987 and 1988 for “Family Ties” as Alex P. Keaton. Later, he won another lead comedy actor Emmy for “Spin City” in 2000, and he won an Emmy for his guest appearance on the drama “Rescue Me” in 2009. His other Emmy noms over the years include guest spots on “Curb Your Enthusiasm,” “Boston Legal” and “The Good Wife.”
	

	Fox has also received four Golden Globes, a Grammy Award and two SAG-AFTRA Actor Awards. He has also been given an honorary Academy Award and the Presidential Medal of Freedom. He was appointed as an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2010, and promoted to Companion of the Order of Canada in June.

	In film, Fox is known for the “Back to the Future” trilogy, as well as “Teen Wolf,” “The Secret of My Success,” “Casualties of War,” “The American President,” “Doc Hollywood” and more. 

	Apple TV’s doc about the star, “Still: A Michael J. Fox Movie,” won four Emmys. Last year, he released his fifth New York Times bestselling book, “Future Boy.”

	Fox first disclosed his diagnosis with young-onset Parkinson’s disease publicly in 1998, and founded The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research in 2000. It’s now the world’s largest nonprofit funder of Parkinson’s research, supporting more than $3 billion in research programs.

	“Michael J. Fox is one of television’s most beloved and enduring performers whose work has left an indelible mark on generations of audiences,” said TV Academy chair Cris Abrego. “The Television Academy is proud to honor him for his extraordinary leadership in advancing Parkinson’s research, transforming public awareness and inspiring global support through The Michael J. Fox Foundation, whose investments have accelerated scientific breakthroughs and the search for a cure. He continues to exemplify compassion, courage and service, reflecting the power of one individual to drive meaningful change.”

	Added TV Academy special awards selection committee co-chair Hillary Bibicoff: “Fox’s advocacy has made a lasting impact around the world, and he has consistently leveraged his platform to inspire meaningful change in the fight against Parkinson’s.” Said co-chair Joseph Litzinger: “His dedication to helping others navigate the challenges of this disease serves as an inspiration to us all.”

	The 78th Emmy Awards, hosted by Mariska Hargitay, broadcasts live from the Peacock Theater at L.A. Live on Monday, Sept. 14, at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on NBC and streaming on Peacock.

schema.headline: Michael J. Fox Will Be Honored With TV Academy’s Bob Hope Humanitarian Award at the Emmys

title: ‘The Thomas Crown Affair’ Trailer: Michael B. Jordan Is a Globetrotting Gentleman Thief in Amazon MGM’s Heist Thriller
description:
Third time’s the charm.

	Amazon MGM Studios has released the trailer for “The Thomas Crown Affair,” which will debut on March 5, 2027.

	The third
body:
Third time’s the charm.

	Amazon MGM Studios has released the trailer for “The Thomas Crown Affair,” which will debut on March 5, 2027.

	The third take on the story of art thief Thomas Crown is the latest directorial effort from Michael B. Jordan, who puts a new spin on the titular billionaire’s heists.


	As Crown, Jordan faces off against a former FBI agent (Adria Arjona) hunting him heist by heist. Meanwhile, an insidious supervillain (Kenneth Branagh) lurks, threatening to take Crown down. But Crown’s true motives are to return precious stolen or sold artifacts to their rightful creators.
	

	“I didn’t want a reboot. I wanted a reimagination. The first two films were about rich white guys stealing for fun. That doesn’t land today,” Jordan told Variety in November. “Ours is more personal. The stakes are higher. Still got the fashion, romance.”


	The trailer first debuted at CinemaCon in April, with Jordan fresh off his best actor Oscar win for “Sinners.” Jordan received his first Academy nod and victory for Ryan Coogler’s vampire horror film. 

	Drew Pearce wrote the script for “The Thomas Crown Affair” from a previous draft by Wes Tooke and Justin Britt-Gibson, based on the 1968 original starring Steve McQueen and Faye Dunaway. Pierce Brosnan and Rene Russo featured in the 1999 remake.

	Jordan and Elizabeth Raposo are producing for Outlier Society, with Charles Roven for Atlas Entertainment. Patrick McCormick and Toberoff Productions’ Marc Toberoff are also producing. Alan Trustman, writer of the original film, is executive producing.
	

	Watch the trailer for “The Thomas Crown Affair” below.

title: Andrew Scott’s ‘Elsinore’ to Open London Film Festival
description:
“Elsinore,” a biographical drama about Scottish actor Ian Charleson starring Andrew Scott, is set to open this year’s BFI London Film Festival.

	Th
body:
“Elsinore,” a biographical drama about Scottish actor Ian Charleson starring Andrew Scott, is set to open this year’s BFI London Film Festival.

	The opening night gala, taking place on Oct. 7, will mark the film’s European premiere with Scott and cast members including Olivia Colman, Billie Piper, Johnny Flynn and Luke Thompson excepted to attend. 

	Directed by Simon Stone (“The Dig”) and written by Stephen Beresford (“Pride”), “Elsinore” tells the “inspiring true story of the actor Ian Charleson, who faced incredible odds while preparing to give the performance of his life in ‘Hamlet’ at the National Theatre in London,” according to its official synopsis. The London Film Festival premiere is particularly special as the Royal Festival Hall, where the gala will be held, is right next door to the National Theatre. 
	

	In addition to leading the film, Scott also has a producing credit on “Elsinore.” Other cast includes Monica Dolan, Matthew Beard, Joe Locke, Georgie Glen, Sadie Soverall, Adeel Akhtar, Dickie Beau and Kadiff Kirwan, with Juliet Stevenson and Peter Mullan. 


	The film will be released wide in U.K. cinemas on Jan. 29 via StudioCanal, and on Nov. 20 via Focus Features in the U.S. Alongside Scott, Andrea Occhipinti of Lucky Red produces with Gabrielle Tana of Magnolia Mae Films, as well as Pete Shilaimon and Mickey Liddell of LD Entertainment and Stefano Massenzi and Carolyn Marks Blackwood.

	“We couldn’t be prouder to be able to present this quintessentially London film on the opening night of the BFI London Film Festival,” Stone said in a statement. “Ian Charleson had many of his greatest triumphs on the stages of the West End, at the Young Vic and of course the National, where he ended his short but dazzling career playing an unforgettable ‘Hamlet.’ We are so lucky to have Andrew Scott, a London Hamlet himself, breathing delicate inspiring life into this beautiful story. I can’t wait to share it with the hometown audience!”
	

	Added Kristy Matheson, BFI London Film Festival artistic director: “Anchored by Andrew Scott’s astounding central performance, few films will leave a lasting imprint on audiences this year quite like Elsinore. Stephen Beresford’s script offers a richly drawn world from which director Simon Stone and his exceptional ensemble of some of the U.K.’s greatest talents vividly bring the story of renowned actor Ian Charleson to the screen. We could not be prouder to open the 70th edition of the BFI London Film Festival with ‘Elsinore,’ a film that centers community, resistance and the triumph of art.”

schema.headline: Andrew Scott’s ‘Elsinore’ to Open London Film Festival

title: ‘Game of Thrones’ Play ‘The Mad King’ First Preview Gets Standing Ovation After Cancellations
description:
“Game of Thrones” play “The Mad King” finally launched previews Tuesday night after cancelling its first week of performances.

	The first ever run-
body:
“Game of Thrones” play “The Mad King” finally launched previews Tuesday night after cancelling its first week of performances.

	The first ever run-through of the HBO/Royal Shakespeare Company co-production, which takes place before the events in HBO’s “Game of Thrones” series, earned a standing ovation from the enraptured audience.

	Addressing the crowd ahead of the show starting, director Dominic Cooke explained that the performance was a world premiere and warned that, because it was a preview, it might be necessary to stop the show in the event of a technical hiccup, in which case the stage manager might come on.
	

	According to local newspaper The Stratford-Upon-Avon Herald, Cooke also said the team hadn’t yet run the entire show through on stage in rehearsals after running out of time and so “he would be seeing it for the first time at the same time as they were.”


	However, the performance ran without a hitch and there were no unscheduled show stops during the four-hour performance.

	A rep for the RSC said the team had already received “incredible” feedback online and via email, which included praise for the acting, sound, lighting and puppetry.

	“It was amazing,” one fan reportedly said. “I loved the set especially the throne. So realistic I felt like I was actually there! The animals particularly the dragon and the horses were so lifelike and the fighting scenes were performed brilliantly. Altogether I feel that I was lucky to be one of the first to see such a masterpiece!”

	Another wrote: “The performances were brilliant across the board, despite it being their first night of the production. The puppetry was easily the most impressive i have ever seen on stage.”
	

	The play, which bears the full title of “George R. R. Martin’s Game Of Thrones: The Mad King,” was due to start previews on July 20 at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre in Stratford-Upon-Avon but, as Variety exclusively reported last week, producers cancelled the first four shows citing “the additional time necessary to progress and refine the work in real time.”

	At the time, a rep for the RSC told Variety the Saturday, July 25 preview would go ahead as planned but it was cancelled hours before the performance was due to start.

	Stratford-Upon-Avon, the birthplace of William Shakespeare, is a two-hour trip from London and a number of ticket-holders expressed their disappointment online, alleging to have arrived from as far afield as Canada.

	In response the RSC has added a handful of extra performances but few tickets are available for the remainder of the show’s two-month run.

	The play is officially set to open Aug. 8.

schema.headline: ‘Game of Thrones’ Play ‘The Mad King’ First Preview Gets Standing Ovation After Cancellations

title: YES, MSG Networks Will Move Streaming Sports to DAZN
description:
The streaming rights to many of New York’s sports teams are traveling.

	MSG Networks and YES Network struck a new partnership that will make DAZN
body:
The streaming rights to many of New York’s sports teams are traveling.

	MSG Networks and YES Network struck a new partnership that will make DAZN  the exclusive direct-to-consumer streaming home of those properties during the 2026-2027 NBA and NHL seasons, a move that seems poised to end a digital joint venture between the two New York-focused sports entities called the Gotham Sports App, which launched in 2024.


	Subscribers within the networks’ regional coverage territories will have access to live Yankees, Knicks, Nets, Rangers, Devils, Islanders and Sabres games, as well as 24/7 feeds of the MSG, MSG Sportsnet, and YES networks, along with original programming. Current users of The Gotham Sports App will continue to receive uninterrupted access to content, but YES and MSG aim migrate users to DAZN during the 2026-2027 NBA and NHL seasons. Exact timing and other details tied to that process will be announced in coming months.
	

	The shift in strategy reflects the continuing challenges faced by regional sports networks. Once dominant sports hubs in specific markets, the cable networks face subscriber erosion spurred by the rise of streaming and cord cutting, as well as new viewing behaviors tied to mobile phones and short-term video clips and highlights.

	The new deal will strengthen DAZN’s lineup of programming.  The company already is best known in the U.S. as a platform for combat sports and soccer. Outside the U.S., DAZN streams NFL Game Pass, NHL.TV, the NBA and NCAA college football and basketball. The deal “underscores our commitmentto expanding our footprint in the United States,” said Shay Segev, CEO, DAZN Group, in a statement.
	

	“Our new strategic partnership with DAZN reflects the YES Network’s continued commitment to elevatethe streaming experience for our direct-to-consumer subscribers and TV Everywhere users,” said Jon Litner, president and CEO, YES Network, in a statement. “DAZN offers a world-class technology platform and elite, live sports streaming expertise, and we look forward to working with them and MSG Networks to continue to serve Yankees and Nets fans, as well as fans of the teams carried by MSG, with the most compelling sports content in the country.”

schema.headline: YES, MSG Networks Will Move Streaming Sports to DAZN

title: The Beatles’ ‘Rubber Soul’ Due for Super Deluxe Treatment: Boxed Set Includes Stereo Remix, Session Outtakes and a Previously Unheard John Lennon Song
description: In the four years since deluxe versions of the Beatles‘ “Revolver” were released, there hasn’t been much debate over what stood at the top of most f
body:
In the four years since deluxe versions of the Beatles‘ “Revolver” were released, there hasn’t been much debate over what stood at the top of most fans’ wish lists: similar treatment given to “Rubber Soul,” the album that preceded “Revolver” in the group’s mid-1960s chronology. With just a little bit of delayed gratification, that hope is coming to fruition, as UMG and Apple Corps will be issuing remixes, expanded editions and boxed sets to commemorate the 1965 classic on Oct. 2.
	

	Producer Giles Martin and engineer Sam Okell have again teamed up for a new set of stereo mixes of the original album tracks, plus a double-sided single of prominent non-album tracks from the same period, “Day Tripper” and “We Can Work It Out.” Many superfans will rejoice in the fact that, unlike the 2022 “Revolver” releases, “Rubber Soul” will have a Dolby Atmos remix from Martin and Okell released in physical format, although this time the Atmos version will come out as its own stand-alone release and not part of the CD boxed set.


	As for outtakes from the original sessions, there are 24 of them collected in the most expansive edition being released in October: “Rubber Soul: Special Edition Super Deluxe.” That boxed set will include 68 tracks in total, whether fans pick it up in five-LP vinyl format or a four-disc CD collection.



	

					Beatles ‘Rubber Soul’ vinyl boxed set product shot
									Apple Corps
	



	Fans’ interest will be particularly piqued by the inclusion of a previously unheard John Lennon composition — or “song outline,” as it is referred to in the promotional materials — named “Little Girl.”
	

	Anyone looking for a taste of what previously unreleased material is included can get some immediate gratification in that regard, as “Michelle (Take 1)” was released concurrent with the official news Wednesday morning. Listen to it here:



	Beatles fans are well aware that different versions of the albums came out in the U.S. and U.K. up through 1966’s “Revolver,” and those differences will be dutifully reflected in the new boxed set. Besides the new remixed stereo version of the British running order, the full set will also include the original U.S. Capitol version of the album, as well as the original mono mix.

	An 88-page hardback book is included with both the LP and CD super deluxe editions. 

	For those not wanting or needing to shell out for the full boxed sets, there will be distillations available, in the form of two-LP and two-CD deluxe (as opposed to super deluxe) versions with a 16-track second disc of demos and sessions.

	The Blu-Ray edition will include the new remix in hi-res 96kHz/24-bit audio as well as the new Dolby Atmos mix, plus four videos. It does not include any of the session outtakes.



	All of the Oct. 2 releases can be pre-ordered through this link. The Beatles’ webstore offers D2C editions of the super deluxe set with two exclusive fold-out posters and two exclusive photo art cards not otherwise available at retail. Prices at the Beatles’ store include $235.98 for the five-LP super deluxe edition; $159.98 for the four-CD super deluxe; $39.98 for the deluxe two-LP set; $24.98 for the deluxe two-CD version; $35.98 for the Blu Ray with hi-def and Dolby mixes; and $35.98 for the Zoetrope single LP.

	Here is a full rundown and track listing for the various editions:

	Rubber Soul – Special Edition Super Deluxe (68 tracks)

	5LP Box Set5LP Box Set, pressed on 180-gram vinyl, with 7” Single, 88-page hardbound book in a 12” x 12”slipcase”


LP1: Rubber Soul (New stereo mix) half-speed mastered: 14 tracks
LP2 & 3: Sessions and Demos (Stereo) half-speed mastered: 26 tracks
LP4: Rubber Soul (Original mono master): 14 tracks
LP5: Rubber Soul (Original Capitol US album): 12 tracks
7”: ‘Day Tripper’ & ‘We Can Work It Out’ (Stereo)



	4CD Box Set4CD Box Set with 88-page hardbound book in a 12” x 12” slipcase:


DISC 1: Rubber Soul (New stereo mix): 14 tracks
DISC 2: Sessions, Demos and the Single (Stereo): 28 tracks
DISC 3: Rubber Soul (Original mono master): 14 tracks
DISC 4: Rubber Soul (Original Capitol US album): 12 tracks



	D2C-exclusive editions of the 5LP and 4CD Super Deluxe Box Sets, featuring an exclusive poster andset of art cards, are also available from the official Beatles Store, alongside a limited-edition Zoetropepicture disc.
	

	Rubber Soul Special Edition Deluxe (30 tracks)

title: Comcast Taps Social Media Reality Series to Tout Xfinity as Tool for Creators, Influencers (EXCLUSIVE)
description: MONTCLAIR, N.J. — Nothing seems amiss in this well-appointed home in a tony New York City suburb…except for the intriguing experiment taking place i
body:
MONTCLAIR, N.J. — Nothing seems amiss in this well-appointed home in a tony New York City suburb…except for the intriguing experiment taking place inside.

	Six college students who have cultivated their own “creator” bases have come here to compete against one another in challenges brought to them by Katie Feeney, the up-and-coming sports influencer who now holds forth on ESPN. Their trials and tribulations will be featured in “Best in Class,” a seven-part competition series that will launch August 5th on the TikTok and Instagram channels of Xfinity, the Comcast-owned TV, broadband and phone connectivity service that is shown powering each person’s efforts. The two-minute episodes will drop weekly.
	

	“There are six different challenges, and they get to put their content-creator skills to the test, and, ultimately, win $100,000 in a brand deal with Xfinity,” Feeney explains during a break in shooting. “At the college age, that’s life changing.”


	In a different era, Comcast used eyebrow-raising TV commercials that tapped familiar figures from the company’s content archive, which includes “E.T.” and “Jurassic Park,” to capture consumer attention. “Best in Class,” however, is aimed at a constituency that doesn’t necessarily watch traditional marketing pitches may not think of Xfinity first when it comes to linking up to the digital realm. Still, the series may give younger consumers, known for their propensity for cord cutting, a new reason to keep Comcast’s services in mind.

	“One of the biggest tools in their toolbox is reliable, badass Internet, right?”  asks Julie Scelzo, Xfinity’s chief creative officer. “These people want to be creators. We are giving them the space and place to do it, with a connection they can’t do it without.”
	

	With this new digital series, Comcast aims to show, rather than tell. Most commercial content hits viewers  with messages, jingles and even cute mascots. “Best in Class” looks much like your garden-variety competition series. At a different time, Feeney might have played Donald Trump to various hopefuls in “The Apprentice.” To get the look and feel of the show right, Xfinity has tapped not only its ad agency, Carmichael Lynch, but Rock Studios, part of NBCUniversal’s ad-sales division. Over years of airing programs such as “Traitors,” “Love Island” and “The Voice,” NBCU knows the ins and outs of the format, says Karen Kovacs, president of ad sales and partnerships. And more advertisers are seeking to create content that matches what people look for in entertainment. Marketers “are asking us to build content that pulls in the culture,” she says.

	Others have tested similar ground. AT&T launched in 2013 a “mobile series” called “@SummerBreak” that followed nine teens fresh out of high school for one last, memorable summer together. To see the “show,” as it were, viewers had to follow the “@SummerBreak” feed on what was then known as Twitter, as well as feeds belonging to the teens. By doing so, they could access links to videos, posts, Tumblrs and more.

	That foray was seen as an experiment to determine whether young people would follow storytelling that played out across social-media platforms. More than a decade later, the research is in: They will. Behind the scenes, “Best in Class” producers are making sure Feeney and her charges are set up to look good in both vertical and horizontal video.

	Xfinity’s new series launches as Comcast is working to generate new activity around its connectivity business, one of the largest pieces of its portfolio. The company has suffered defections from its traditional cable and broadband businesses as younger consumers  find different services to connect them to digital realms. Comcast has made “significant changes in pricing and packaging to make our value proposition clearer and more predictable, continued investment in a simpler, more seamless customer experience and a more aggressive push into wireless,” said Mike Cavanagh, co-CEO of the company, during a recent call with investors.
	

	Meanwhile, projections for the health of the so-called “creator economy” are robust. The global creator economy market was valued at $252.3 billion in 2025 and is expected to surpass $310 billion by 2026, according to estimates from Grand View Research.

	Key to new types of promotion like “Best in Class” is that they not seem like pieces of hard sell. Still, the show may hinge on certain points that burnish Xfinity. “What we set out to do, is make something that’s interesting and entertaining that people want to be part of,”  says Scelzo, “and showing that Xfinity is an integral part of what creators do on the daily.”

	On set, the group of young would-be influencers seemed to focus more closely on the contest than on the flurry of activity around them. That’s the way it should be, says Feeney. “When you are in your 20s and you’re trying to figure out what you want to do, there’s so many outside voices. I think the best thing you can do is just stay true to yourself and stick with what you’re passionate about, and turn off the noise around you,” she says, adding: “It’s good to not care what anyone thinks. And that’s the advice I really give to anyone.”

                          Mom Fires Off Subpoenas ...
                          Over TikTo
body:
Nolan Wells
                          Mom Fires Off Subpoenas ...
                          Over TikTok, Instagram & Other Social Media Data
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              July 28, 2026
                            6:42 PM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  July 29, 2026
                                5:44 AM PDT
                                    
              
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Nolan Wells’ mother, Christine Wells-Wonsley, is making moves in court to get her hands on her late son’s social media accounts, TMZ has learned. 
      
    
            TMZ obtained court docs filed by Christine on Tuesday, revealing she fired off subpoenas to the companies behind Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Life360, Snapchat and TikTok. During the search, Christine used Life360 to track Nolan's phone and compared the location history between Snapchat and the tracking app, but found that the data didn't match.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The subpoenas request the social media companies turn over all materials and information related to Nolan's account.
      

            Christine wants all current and prior usernames, email addresses, phone numbers, and display names. In addition, she is asking for all IP addresses tied to actions on the account, including logins, password resets, and metadata. 
      
    
            The subpoenas also request all IP addresses tied to friend events on the account, information that identifies or may be used to identify any party messaging in a conversation with the account, all posts, stories, chats, messages and DMS, and all photos, video recordings, contents, text files, GPS data, friend-list history and other information stored. 
      
    
            As TMZ previously reported, Nolan was found dead after going missing on July 4, after partying with friends at Horn Island.
      
    
            The 18-year-old's friends told investigators Nolan did not leave the island with them. The friends claimed Nolan planned to stay behind with a girl.

title: D4vd Murder Case: Foul Odor From Celeste Rivas' Remains Filled Medical Examiner's Hallway
description:

                          Celeste's Remains Left Strong Odor at Coroner's Office
body:
D4vd Murder Case
                          Celeste's Remains Left Strong Odor at Coroner's Office
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              July 28, 2026
                            5:00 PM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Gruesome photos of Celeste Rivas' dismembered and decomposing remains were shown during D4vd's preliminary hearing ... but testimony about the unimaginable smell was just as powerful.
      
    
            Dr. Grant Ho of the Los Angeles County Department of Medical Examiner told the judge the odor emanating from the teen's remains was so overwhelming they could actually be smelled down the hall before being brought into the examination room for the autopsy.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The horrifying detail is compelling because it was the smell of her decomposing remains that resulted in the case being opened in the first place ... the odor leading to the grisly discovery last September inside a Hollywood tow yard.
      

            Prosecutors say the Tesla where Celeste's remains were found was loaded with air fresheners ... 11 in total.
      
    
            After five days of detailed and graphic testimony from 12 different witnesses during D4vd's preliminary hearing ... the judge ordered the murder case to proceed to trial, which must begin within 90 days.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            D4vd is facing a murder charge with special circumstances, which makes him eligible for the death penalty ... though prosecutors haven't made a decision either way about seeking capital punishment.
      
    
            He is also charged with continuous sexual abuse of a child under the age of 14, and unlawful mutilation of human remains. He has pleaded not guilty.

title: Wife & 6 Kids Reportedly Murdered After Accusing Husband of Affair
description:
Michigan Murder-Suicide
                          Wife & 6 Kids Killed After Husband Accused of Affair
body:
Michigan Murder-Suicide
                          Wife & 6 Kids Killed After Husband Accused of Affair
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              July 28, 2026
                            5:41 PM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  July 29, 2026
                                6:06 AM PDT
                                    
              
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            A wife was allegedly murdered alongside her 6 kids ... 2 years after posting online that her husband was having an affair with a younger intern.
      
    
            According to law enforcement, Kristopher Karolkiewicz shot and killed his wife, Amanda "Mandy" Karolkiewicz, and their 6 children on July 24 in their home in Grand Haven Township, MI. They say he then set their home on fire before shooting himself.
      
    
            The Detroit News reports that a Reddit account they independently verified was linked to Mandy -- based on matching details about marriage dates, kids, ages, jobs and where they lived -- reveals the couple had a rough relationship, and once accused Kristopher of cheating.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The account for username "MandyK1179" mentioned her husband's alleged affair back in 2024, commenting in a thread ... "He was divorced and older than me … fast forward ten years and five kids, he was cheating with the intern again -- the same age I was when I was the intern."
      

            Mandy's post continued ... "After about a year of self-loathing, I remember crying and looking at myself in the mirror and realizing how (expletive) it was that I was the one who was living so miserably because of what he did. I finally realized that I had been the only person who has ever showed up for myself my whole entire life."
      
    
            The post explained that she only stayed with her husband for their kids ... "I kept telling myself, 'I love my kids more than I hate my husband right now.' They have no idea -- I faked it 'till we made it. We're in a much better place 4.5 years out, but it's still a fight to stay in a healthy place."
      
    
            In the "As One After Infidelity" subreddit, the post written by Mandy mentioned ignoring "major red flags" from her husband, and encouraged him to go to therapy ... as well as proposing marriage counseling.
      
    
            The post details how she allegedly shoved him after finding out he was having an "emotional" affair, saying ... "He towers over me and destroyed me mentally. It felt like I was being assaulted and needed to fight back. I think it's a fight or flight thing."
      
    
            The Reddit post also discussed whether or not she felt safe with her husband, explaining ... "For me, 'safety' is the ability to trust that (he) will not get angry or defensive when I’m triggered, and will help to carry me through it"
      
    
            Mandy's post continued ... "We’re almost five years out, and he’s trying, but still struggles with defensiveness. But in general, am I happy? Yes. I wouldn’t say I feel safety in my emotions, because he still struggles with receiving my triggers without defensiveness, and that’s slowing down my ability to regain feelings of safety."
      
    
            Mandy was 39.
      
    
            The kids' ages ranged from 5 to 15.
      
    
            RIP

schema.headline: Wife & 6 Kids Reportedly Murdered After Accusing Husband of Affair
